text:
Anna (Product): idea: add a tiny routing/quota hint to each saved-query row so users can see expected cost/latency before running
Samir (Platform): thumbs-up. do we want a static estimate or a live preview API? Live gives fresher numbers but heavier
Mike R (Console): row-level chip with hover for details seems best. keep list density in mind. maybe a condensed pill that expands into a quick-inspector
Jessie (Eng): backend plan: expose /internal/route_preview?route_id=<id>&window=1h which returns sampled aggregates only (median_cost, p95_latency, sample_rate, policy_version, fallback_models)
Samir (Platform): include policy_version in response so UI can flag stale previews when routing rules have changed
Anna (Product): UX: show cost (token estimate) + small lightning icon for latency. on hover show: source window, sample_rate, last_updated and a link to "run live sample"
Mike R (Console): accessibility note: chip must have aria-label and keyboard open for inspector. also color contrast for latency badges
Jessie (Eng): implementation detail: we will not compute at render time for large lists. preview requests should be batched by route and cached for 2min TTL. invalidation trigger: routing policy update or model-pin edit
Samir (Platform): also add a sampling_rate field. frontend should divide by sampling_rate to present normalized estimates and we need to log preview.snapshot_created events for audit
Anna (Product): wording for hover help: "Estimates are computed from sampled recent traffic for this route. Actual cost depends on input lengths and model selection. Run a live sample for exact billing."
Mike R (Console): micro-UX: when user edits saved-query route-pin, show a small "preview stale" indicator until preview re-runs. default auto-retry after 2s idle, or a manual "Refresh preview" button
Jessie (Eng): safety: auto-retry capped to 1 per 5s for small accounts, opt-out in prefs for enterprise to avoid accidental load spikes
Samir (Platform): backend note: preview endpoint will accept policy_version param to compute against a specific rule snapshot for reproducibility
Anna (Product): product asks: should we show fallback model cost comparisons inline? e.g., cost/latency of nearest compatible models
Mike R (Console): yes but keep it collapsed by default. show top 2 fallbacks with tiny sparkline of latency if available
Jessie (Eng): we can return a compact array: [ {model:"redwood-7b-q4", median_cost:"0.12", p95:"180ms"}, ... ] ; frontend renders minimal table in hover
Samir (Platform): remember to gate preview data for privacy: only surface aggregates, and apply role-based access (no per-request logs)
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: /internal/route_preview v1 -> staging at 2024-08-02T09:00Z
Anna (Product): next steps: I'll make two mock variants (chip-only vs inspector) by Friday, create ADR for API shape and privacy guards, and a small perf checklist
Mike R (Console): will check density + keyboard flow when mocks are ready
Jessie (Eng): I'll prototype endpoint and sampling-normalization; will include sampling_rate in response
Samir (Platform): I'll add cache invalidation hooks and audit events
Anna (Product): thanks all :pray:
